mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE user_id = #{query.userId} AND deleted = 0) AS projects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project WHERE user_id = #{query.userId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = #{query.activeProjectStatus}) AS active_projects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_requirement JOIN project ON project.id = project_requirement.project_id WHERE project.user_id = #{query.userId} AND project.deleted = 0 AND project_requirement.deleted = 0) AS requirements, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_defect JOIN project ON project.id = project_defect.project_id WHERE project.user_id = #{query.userId} AND project.deleted = 0 AND project_defect.deleted = 0 AND project_defect.status <> #{query.closedDefectStatus}) AS defects, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mf_note WHERE user_id = #{query.userId} AND deleted = 0) AS notes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mf_blog_post WHERE user_id = #{query.userId}) AS blogs, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM daily_review WHERE user_id = #{query.userId} AND deleted = 0) AS reviews, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mf_ai_conversation WHERE user_id = #{query.userId}) AS conversations, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mf_mail WHERE user_id = #{query.userId} AND folder = #{query.inboxFolder} AND unread = 1) AS unread, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(opening_balance), 0) FROM mf_finance_account WHERE user_id = #{query.userId}) + (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN transaction_type = #{query.incomeType} THEN amount ELSE -amount END), 0) FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{query.userId}) AS assets, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{query.userId} AND transaction_date >= #{query.monthStart} AND transaction_date < #{query.nextMonth} AND transaction_type = #{query.incomeType}) AS income, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM mf_finance_transaction WHERE user_id = #{query.userId} AND transaction_date >= #{query.monthStart} AND transaction_date < #{query.nextMonth} AND transaction_type = #{query.expenseType}) AS expense
SELECT id, name, status, updated_time FROM project WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY updated_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT id, review_date, LEFT(content, 160) AS preview FROM daily_review WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY review_date DESC LIMIT 5
